subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

The team played / extremely / good / during the match.
solution:
The Correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Adverbs like **"extremely"** modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
 
• In this sentence, **"extremely" **modifies the adjective **"good."**
